subject: How to connect our custom domain name?

body: We are getting ready to launch our paid plans. Where in the admin portal do we paste our Stripe API Publishable and Secret Keys, and does BD support 3D Secure verification? Regards, Elena

subject: Importing 1,200 categories via CSV - format question
body: Hi, I have a spreadsheet of 1,200 tech industry subcategories. How should the CSV columns be formatted (Top Category vs Sub Category), and is there an import size limit? David

subject: Setting up social media links in the header and footer
body: Hi team, which settings tab do we use to link our Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn pages so the icons show up across the site? Thanks!

subject: How to configure location radius search for plumbers?
body: Customers are complaining that searching by zip code only shows exact zip matches. How do we enable a 25-mile radius search for our members? Robert

body: We want to have a free tier with basic profile fields and a $49/mo tier with photo galleries and direct inquiry forms. How do we configure these membership plans? Amanda

body: Hi, our member directory maps are displaying 'For development purposes only'. How do we generate and enter our Google Maps API key into the platform? Kevin

body: Hello, we want emails sent to info@myvet.org to automatically forward to our personal Gmail addresses. Is this done inside BD or at our domain registrar? Jessica

subject: How does automatic lead matching work?
body: When a customer submits a project quote request, how does the system match and distribute that lead to qualified local contractors? Liam

subject: Changing font styles and primary brand color

subject: How do members cancel their recurring subscriptions themselves?

subject: URGENT: Stripe checkout returning Error 402 on checkout page
body: Our members cannot sign up today! Whenever someone submits payment on the checkout page, it fails with 'Card Declined / Error 402'. We verified our Stripe dashboard has no outages. Please troubleshoot immediately!

subject: Member search results showing blank page after category filter
body: When users click the 'Italian' cuisine subcategory, the results page displays an empty white container even though 18 restaurants are categorized under Italian. Please help us fix this bug.

body: Our site profiles are suddenly showing 'Oops! Something went wrong' with a grey map background. Did our Google Maps API key quota expire or do we need to re-authorize the domain?

subject: Welcome emails going straight to spam folder for new members
body: Several new members told us they never received their account verification emails. We found them in their Gmail Spam folders. How do we configure SPF and DKIM records to fix deliverability?

subject: CSV upload failed with error: 'Column header mismatch'
body: I tried uploading our 500 writer records via CSV import, but the system keeps throwing 'Error: Column header mismatch at row 1'. Can you inspect our file headers or tell us the exact required schema?

subject: SSL Certificate expired warning showing in Chrome browser
body: Our domain www.mariagefrance.com is showing an 'Insecure Connection / NET::ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID' error to visitors. How do we renew the SSL on BD?

subject: Member profile photo upload getting stuck at 100%
body: When members try to upload a JPEG profile picture larger than 2MB, the progress bar sticks at 100% and never saves. Is there an image size limit or server timeout setting?

subject: Lead notifications not forwarding to tutor SMS
body: We activated SMS alerts for instant lead matching, but none of our tutors received text messages today when student inquiries came in. Where do we verify the webhook integration?

subject: Duplicate invoice generated for renewing member #1042
body: Member #1042 was charged twice on October 1st for their annual subscription renewal. Why did the cron job generate duplicate charges?

subject: Zip code distance radius showing results 500 miles away
body: When searching for therapists within 10 miles of 90210, doctors in New York are appearing in the list. Is our geocoding database unsynced?

subject: Project Request: Custom Airbnb-style interactive calendar booking widget
body: We want to build a custom interactive calendar booking system where guests can select check-in and check-out dates directly on a host's profile, calculate seasonal pricing dynamically, and pay via Escrow. Can your team build this custom module?

subject: Project: Integrating Epic EMR FHIR API for Doctor Credential Verification
body: We need an automated integration with Epic FHIR healthcare APIs to verify physician medical licenses upon signup before publishing their profile. What would be the timeline and architectural scope for this?

subject: Feature Request: Multi-vendor marketplace checkout with split payments
body: We want visitors to add services from 3 different wedding vendors into one shopping cart and split the payments automatically via Stripe Connect. Can you scope this project for us?

subject: Custom mobile app development (iOS & Android) with push alerts
body: We want native iOS and Android apps connected to our directory database with push notifications for leads. We need an estimate and technical proposal.

subject: Project Proposal: Multi-language switcher (Spanish, English, French)
body: Our marketplace is expanding into Europe. We need full multilingual support including localized category URLs and currency conversion. Can we schedule a scoping call this Thursday?

subject: Web3 Metamask login integration for member authentication
body: We want our users to sign in with their Ethereum wallet (SIWE) instead of traditional email/passwords. How complex is this to add to our BD site?

subject: Please cancel my subscription and issue a full refund immediately

subject: Immediate cancellation request for account #9941
body: Hello, we are shutting down our business operations at the end of this month. Please make sure our recurring subscription of $199/month does not charge on November 1st. Please confirm cancellation.

subject: Charged after requesting cancellation 2 weeks ago - refund needed
body: I emailed support two weeks ago asking to terminate our plan. Today I was billed $250! This is completely unacceptable. I want a full refund of this unauthorized charge immediately.

subject: Downgrade from Enterprise to Basic tier and pro-rate credit
body: We are a non-profit and cannot afford the Enterprise tier. Can you downgrade our account to Basic and credit the remaining 7 months of our prepaid contract?

subject: Billing dispute: double charge on invoice #8812
body: Your billing system ran my credit card twice on September 28th ($99 twice). Please refund the duplicate $99 transaction immediately.

subject: Cancellation within 14-day trial period
body: Hi, I am within my 14-day trial window. Please cancel my account so my credit card on file is not charged when the trial concludes tomorrow.

subject: OUTRAGEOUS: Site downtime cost us thousands this morning!

subject: Your latest update broke our custom member search bar

body: I opened a critical ticket 48 hours ago regarding database errors and haven't received a single human reply. Is anyone actually running support?

subject: Unacceptable bug in member signup form losing leads

subject: Poor mobile responsiveness on iPhone screens

subject: Misleading advertising regarding included plugins
body: When we bought the package, your rep said the lead distribution plugin was included. Now the admin panel says 'Upgrade to unlock'. I feel scammed.

subject: Quote Request: Migrating 15,000 members from WordPress directory
